name: Create integration
description: Create integration Creates a new integration for the specified application. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/one/integrations
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/one/integrations
Creates a new integration for the specified application. Integration creation with OAuth is not supported by API at the moment. For other auth methods, use `GET /v2/applications/{application_id}/credential-guide` to see the required credential structure and example payloads for each vendor.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account identifier.; body (body)

name: Delete integration
description: Delete integration Delete an integration by soft-deleting it. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/one/integrations/{id}

name: Get auth methods
description: Get auth methods Returns available auth methods for the specified vendor, including credential schema, instructions, and example payloads. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/one/applications/{application_id}/auth-methods
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/one/applications/{application_id}/auth-methods
Returns available auth methods for the specified vendor, including credential schema, instructions, and example payloads. Use this to understand what credentials are required before calling POST /v2/integrations.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account identifier.; application_id (path) — Application/vendor identifier.
Optional: page (query) — A page number within the paginated result set.; page_size (query) — Number of results to return per page.

name: Get application setup flows
description: Get application setup flows Returns all available setup flows for the application, one per auth method. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/one/applications/{application_id}/setup-flows
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/one/applications/{application_id}/setup-flows
Returns all available setup flows for the application, one per auth method.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account identifier.; application_id (path) — Application/vendor identifier.
Optional: auth_method (query) — Filter by auth method id. Get available ids from GET /v2/applications.; environment (query) — Filter by environment.; page (query) — A page number within the paginated result set.; page_size (query) — Number of results to return per page.

name: Get application details
description: Get application details Returns full application details including auth methods, use cases, and permissions. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/one/applications/{application_id}

name: Get integration details
description: Get integration details Returns full integration details including use cases and permissions. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/one/integrations/{id}

name: List applications
description: List applications Returns a list of available applications with use cases and permissions. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/one/applications
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/one/applications
Returns a list of available applications with use cases and permissions.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account identifier.
Optional: environment (query) — Filter by supported environment (standard, fedramp).; page (query) — A page number within the paginated result set.; page_size (query) — Number of results to return per page.

name: List integrations
description: List integrations Returns a paginated list of integrations for the account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/one/integrations
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/one/integrations
Returns a paginated list of integrations for the account.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account identifier.
Optional: application (query) — Filter by application/vendor (e.g., GOOGLE_WORKSPACE, MICROSOFT_INTERNAL).; direction (query) — Direction to order results.; dlp_enabled (query) — Filter by DLP enabled status (true/false).; order (query) — Field to order results by.; page (query) — Page number within the paginated result set.; page_size (query) — Number of results per page.; search (query) — Search integrations by name or application.; status (query) — Filter by integration status.; use_cases (query) — Filter by enabled use cases (e.g., casb, ces). Matches integrations enrolled in any of the specified values. Can be specified multiple times.

name: Pause integration
description: Pause integration Pauses an integration, stopping all crawlers. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/one/integrations/{id}/pause
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/one/integrations/{id}/pause
Pauses an integration, stopping all crawlers.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account identifier.; id (path) — Integration ID.

name: Resume integration
description: Resume integration Resumes a paused integration, restarting crawlers. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/one/integrations/{id}/resume
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/one/integrations/{id}/resume
Resumes a paused integration, restarting crawlers.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account identifier.; id (path) — Integration ID.

name: Update integration
description: Update integration Updates an integration's name, permissions, DLP profiles, use cases, or credentials. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/one/integrations/{id}
context:
PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/one/integrations/{id}
Updates an integration's name, permissions, DLP profiles, use cases, or credentials.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare account identifier.; id (path) — Integration ID.
Optional: body (body)
